en-US.longDescription: ISOCreator (could also be called Folder-to-ISO or Directory-to-ISO) is a C#.NET 2.0 application which creates ISO 9660 Joliet CD images from a given folder or volume. It can also create ISO with virtual files, given a tree representing a directory structure.
en-US.name: ISO Creator
